cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've stirred sugar into my tea like you. Ready to open the scholarship letter, once we find clean teaspoons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't take sugar. My spoon's clean; use it and open the letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, a clean spoon first. I'll need another cup now; this one's sweet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take mine. Are you scared of going, or staying here with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If we swap, we'll need to mark which has sugar. Have you got a pen that writes on mugs?

reason: Replace detachable Stance phrases with particular copied cues and corrections, making A adapt the exact Drive while B pursues a plausible immediate concern.
